components.name: Strawberry Rhubarb Mix
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and set aside.

components.name: Cake
directions: Spray the inside of a Bundt pan with cooking spray.
Cream butter and sugar. Add eggs one at a time. Add vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and baking powder. In another bowl, mix yogurt and milk.
Alternate adding flour mixture and yogurt mixture to the butter mixture, beginning and ending with flour.
Place clumps of batter in the bottom of the pan, followed by the strawberry rhubarb mixture. Repeat layers until finished.
Cool 10 minutes in pan, then invert onto a plate.
